narrative:
Chart of Accounts administration — the Capita planning COA is mapped to the GL accounts shared from the Databricks finance lakehouse across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow.

AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped GL accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard P&L accounts such as delivery payroll, subcontractor costs and KPI service credits.

signals.title: GL account export FY2025
signals.excerpt: Active GL accounts mapped to planning leaf accounts; a small number of legacy codes from the contact centre disposal need re-mapping.
